sentences.text: Wellbore 15/9-F-11 T2 has drilling reports from 2013-03-23 to 2013-05-14, in 53 reports, and a well duration of 52.96 d.
The deepest measured depth is 4562.1 m with a true vertical depth of 3398.2 m on that report.
Total activity time is 1230.5 h, of which primary lost time is 177.75 h, or 14.45 % of the activity time.

The wellbore is a technical sidetrack of 15/9-F-11, which Sodir lists with purpose observation and status P&A, so the Sodir facts are the parent's. The sidetrack drilled the 26 in, 17.5 in and 8.5 in sections to total depth, was then plugged back with cement, and operations were transferred to the next sidetrack F-11 A.
Sodir gives an entry date of 2013-03-07, a completion date of 2013-05-12 (the end of drilling, not production start-up) and a total depth of 4562.0 m.
The completion date is earlier than the last report because the reports continue with the final cement plugs, the drill-out of cement and the kick-off to F-11 A on 2013-05-14.

Section 1 is a 26 in hole drilled from 2013-03-23 to 2013-04-12, from 257.0 m to 1365.0 m measured depth, ending at a true vertical depth of 1340.5 m, with 1108.0 m of new hole and an average rate of 16.0 m/h while coded drilling -- drill (not an on-bottom rate of penetration).

Section 2 is a 17.5 in hole drilled from 2013-04-13 to 2013-04-27, from 1368.0 m to 2577.0 m measured depth, ending at a true vertical depth of 2444.0 m, with 1212.0 m of new hole and an average rate of 14.87 m/h while coded drilling -- drill (not an on-bottom rate of penetration).

Section 3 is an 8.5 in hole drilled from 2013-04-28 to 2013-05-08, from 2577.0 m to 4562.1 m measured depth, ending at a true vertical depth of 3398.2 m, with 1985.1 m of new hole and an average rate of 14.0 m/h while coded drilling -- drill (not an on-bottom rate of penetration).

Section 4 has an unknown hole size (the reports do not state one), runs from 2013-05-09 to 2013-05-14 and starts at 4562.0 m and ends at 4562.1 m measured depth, with a true vertical depth of 3398.2 m at section end; it drilled 0.0 m of new hole, so no drilling rate applies; it holds the plug-back cementing and the kick-off to F-11 A.
Section 1 starts below a casing shoe at 202.3 m and a casing string was set with its shoe at 1357.7 m.
Section 2 starts below the shoe at 1357.7 m and a casing string was set with its shoe at 2570.7 m.
Section 3 starts below the shoe at 2570.7 m and no casing was set in it, so the well was left open hole to total depth.
Section 4 also starts below the shoe at 2570.7 m and no casing was set in it; the section was plugged with cement.
Primary lost time by section is 72.5 h in section 1 (15.28 % of its activity time), 86.5 h in section 2 (24.03 %), 0.0 h in section 3 (0.0 %) and 18.75 h in section 4 (14.2 %).
By cause, primary lost time is 74.0 h of waiting on weather, 71.0 h of repair and 32.75 h of waiting, which sum to the wellbore primary total of 177.75 h, or 14.45 % of the wellbore activity time.

Possible lost time is reported separately and is not part of the primary figures: it totals 119.5 h, or 9.71 % of the wellbore activity time, made up of 73.25 h coded interruption -- maintain and 46.25 h coded interruption -- other.
Possible lost time by section is 104.75 h in section 1 (22.08 % of its activity time), 7.0 h in section 2 (1.94 %), 7.75 h in section 3 (2.94 %) and 0.0 h in section 4.

On 2013-03-24 the crown block fast-line sheave bearing was found seized on its shaft, which led to pulling the 26 in BHA and several days of sheave change-out and BOP annular repair before drilling resumed; the first logged activity of this event lasted 4.0 h and is classed as possible lost time.
On 2013-04-04 a 20 in casing joint with damaged box threads was pulled and replaced and the backup wellhead assembly was made up, a 6.0 h primary repair.

Riser and BOP installation problems followed: on 2013-04-06 a riser flange could not be made up because the studs were too long (5.5 h), and on 2013-04-07 a missing o-ring was found on a riser connection and replaced after a failed test (6.0 h), both primary lost time.

From 2013-04-14 to 2013-04-19 the rig waited on weather because cuttings from the ISO tanks could not be back-loaded to the supply vessel in heavy wind and sea; single entries run 8.0 h on 2013-04-14, 16.0 h on 2013-04-15 and 15.5 h on 2013-04-19, and waiting on weather totals 74.0 h over 15 activities in sections 1 and 2.
While running the intermediate casing on 2013-04-24 a drawworks failure was troubleshot for 5.0 h of primary lost time.
On 2013-04-27 the SoundTrack tool was troubleshot after pulling to near surface, 5.0 h of primary lost time at the end of the 17.5 in section.

After total depth the open hole was plugged back with cement: the first cement plug was pumped on 2013-05-10, and on 2013-05-11 a 12.25 h entry coded as waiting on cement (primary) also covers a BOP pressure test and top drive encoder troubleshooting, so it likely overstates true waiting time.

The last cement plug was set on 2013-05-12, hard cement was tagged and the plug was drilled out, and on 2013-05-14 the well was kicked off to F-11 A, which explains why reporting continues after the Sodir completion date.

Plan cuttings back-loading and ISO tank capacity with weather in mind, because waiting on weather cost 74.0 h of primary lost time, mostly from 2013-04-14 onward while the hole was already drilled and cleaned.

Inspect and grease the crown block sheaves and check riser flange studs and o-rings on the deck before the rig is committed to the well, since the sheave failure on 2013-03-24 and the riser faults on 2013-04-06 and 2013-04-07 together drove most of the repair and possible lost time in section 1.

Inspect casing thread boxes and handling equipment before running casing, given the damaged joint found on 2013-04-04 and the drawworks failure on 2013-04-24, which together cost 11.0 h of primary repair time in those two events.

Code plug-back operations so that BOP tests and other work done while cement sets are not booked as waiting on cement, because the 18.75 h of section 4 primary lost time is all coded as waiting and the 12.25 h entry on 2013-05-11 contains productive work.

Record the hole size for plug-back and kick-off sections in the reports, because section 4 has an unknown hole size in the data, and keep the Sodir completion date and the last report date reconciled in the end-of-well documentation, since the sidetrack reported until 2013-05-14.

row.comments:
Checked crown block fast-line sheave and found bearing ceased onto shaft. Evaluated situation and informed offshore and onshore managment. Prepared forward plan to POOH 26" BHA prior to working on fast-line sheave. Barriered off rig floor and cantelever.

Meanwhile:
Circulated well 1100 l/min, 8 bar, 20 RPM, 2 kNm. Attempted to apply lubricant to fast-line sheave.

Broke out wellhead from string and laid down same to deck.
Pulled out of hole with 20" casing string from 1208 m to 1195 m and broke out joint with damaged box threads, laid down same to deck.
Picked up and made up new 20" casing joint and ran in hole to 1208 meter.
Changed to 5 1/2" handling equipment.
Prepared backup wellhead on HTS, made up same to running tool.
Picked up and made up backup wellhead assembly.
Installed  plug set in backup wellhead assembly.

Not able to make up flange between riser joints due to studs too long.
Technical Team fabricated spacer washer for shimming hydraulic jacks.

Meanwhile:
Rigged up wires for guide line system in moonpool.
Prepared next riser joints on cantilever deck.

Broke out connection between riser joints #6 and #3 and inspected same.
Found o-ring missing.
Installed o-ring in outer groove.
Made up connection between riser joints #6 and #3 and re-tested same to 35 bar, test ok.

Waited on weather.
Not able to back load cuttings from ISO tanks to supply vessel due to heavy wind and sea.

Meanwhile:
Circulated hole clean at 1500 meter with 4300 liter/min, 248 bar.
Pulled back into shoe.
Circulated with 1440 liter/min, 35 bar.
Picked up and racked back 5 1/2" DP.

Waited on weather.
Not able to back load cuttings from ISO tanks to supply vessel due to heavy wind and sea.

Meanwhile:
Circulated with 1440 liter/min, 35 bar.
Picked up and racked back 5 1/2" DP, 23 stands racked back.

Waited on weather to back load cuttings.

Meanwhile:
Circulated with 1420 lpm,  33 bar, 0 rpm.

Troubleshoot drawwork failure.

Meanwhile: 
Removed auto slips and lowered 14" casing hanger below rotary in a controlled sequence, Up/Dw weight 430/320 MT. Installed master bushing and made up circulation swedge. Circulated with 200 lpm, 9 bar, 14" casing shoe at 2433 m.
Troubleshoot SoundTrack tool. POOH to 7 m and plugged into OnTrack tool, verified software communication.

Pumped 11.8 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Mixed and pumped 10 m3 of 1.90 sg cement slurry. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 890 l of drill water. Reset stroke counters. Pumped 2.8 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Displaced the cement with 40.6 m3 (1833 strokes) of 1.32 sg OBM. Underdisplaced with 2.5m3.

Rotated with 20 rpm and 15 kNm during displacement.

Waited on cement.

Meanwhlie: Performed prejob meeting prior to pick up and make up BOP test tool. Removed PS21 slips and installed master bushings. Picked up and made up BOP test tool, removed protective tape and inspected seals. Ran in hole with BOP test tool on 5 1/2" drill pipe to wellhead at 138m MD. Displaced riser and surface lines to sea water.

Pressure tested BOP to 345 bar.  Pressure tested standpipe manifold to 345 bar.

Displaced BOP to surface to 1.32 sg OBM. Pulled out of hole with BOP test tool on 5 1/2" drill pipe from 138 m MD. Broke out and laid down same.

Troubleshooting on top drive encoder. Function tested same. Function tested 3 1/2" auto slips. Performed general maintanence and housekeeping.

Pressure tested cement line to 200 bar and verified line up. 

Pumped 20 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Mixed and pumped 13.5 m3 of 2.00 SG cement slurry. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 790 l of drill water. Pumped 3.3 m3 of 1.50 SG spacer. Displaced the cement with 24 m3 (1083 strokes) of 1.28 sg OBM.

Kicked off to F-11 A by drilling from 2578m MD to 2586m MDwith 1800 lpm, 120 bar and 60 rpm. 50% cement / formation in returns verified at 2586m MD.

****Transferred operations to F-11 A****
